rows.label: Weakened Pharaoh Predasite
rows.note: capture only after Infested damage it

conditions: A healthy capture gives only Pharaoh Predasite Tags, and nothing shows up in Son's Revivification menu.
Your own damage never weakens it; only Deimos Infested do.
Predasites resist Warframe abilities and fight back, so they take two tranq darts.
bonuses: Fass is when Infested are aggressive and plentiful, which is what the weakening needs.
Tags from extra captures trade to Son for the Son Tokens gilding needs.

disclosures.title: getting the Weakened hit
disclosures.body: Tranq it first, then bring Infested to it. Throwing a Pherliac Pod on the sleeping animal makes Infested converge and attack it; the pod's blueprint and parts drop from Juggernauts and it costs 7,500 credits to build. Invisibility (Ivara's Prowl and Sleep Arrow work well) keeps aggro off you. Two players said Infested can't actually kill it: once its health hits zero you can walk up and collect it. One player reported 21 Pharaohs in 45 minutes of Fass with Pheromone Glands and the Echo-Lure. Avoid boosting in Archwing, which disrupts spawns.

conditions: Only a gilded Pharaoh earns Mastery; gilding resets it to rank 0, so level it to 30 twice.
Once one gilded Pharaoh hits rank 30, a later Pharaoh with a different Mutagen or Antigen gives no more Mastery.
Its Beast Claws level but give no Mastery.
bonuses: Son Tokens also come from tag trades, pickups on the Drift and Grandmother's Mend the Family trade.
